title: End-to-end: a single-phase, rollout-searched exploration lane raises the search's best held-out success
hypothesis: Single-phase generation plus rollout search supplies stronger exploration candidates that survive selection against the unchanged fittable lane and improve the run's selected incumbent.

prediction.against: the current config/two_lane_search.yaml run (fresh rerun, same model and manifests) — each run's performance incumbent scored on the same fresh confirmation cases
prediction.rationale: The fittable lane already reaches ~0.98-1.00 (gen0_cand1/cand5), so the headroom at the incumbent is small; 0.05 on fresh cases would show the new lane can supply or beat the incumbent. Secondary: exploration-lane best confirmation success, new vs old (D-014 predicts a large gain).

protocol.command: for each block b in 0..5: python scripts/run_full_evolution.py --config config/two_lane_search.yaml (run seed 3100+2b) and --config config/two_lane_search_v2.yaml (run seed 3101+2b); then python scripts/evaluate_on_fresh_manifest.py --pool-seed 313b on both incumbents
code_changes: lares/core/policy_generation.py (exploration lane: single-phase generation with a code-derived idea record)
lares/core/training_pipeline.py (exploration lane: 24-candidate independent rollout search on the probe, checkpoint tie rule)
lares/search/schemas.py, lares/search/lanes.py (code-derived ideas and a searched exploration lane, without weakening lineage validation)

falsified_by: Upper paired 95% bound below +0.05 for incumbent-vs-incumbent on the fresh cases refutes; an interval spanning zero is inconclusive. Report the exploration-lane comparison separately.

metrics.incumbent_lane: fittable in all 12 runs (promotion-set success 1.00 in all)

controls.note: control is a fresh rerun of config/two_lane_search.yaml per block; the metric is already v2 minus control incumbent success on the block's fresh cases

result.notes: Six paired blocks (control seeds 3100-3110 even, v2 seeds 3101-3111 odd), each pair's performance incumbents scored on that block's fresh 50-case manifest (pool seeds 3130-3135). v2 minus control incumbent success per block [0.0, 0.02, 0.0, -0.06, 0.0, 0.0]; run-level mean -0.0067, paired t95 (5 df) [-0.0353, +0.0220]: the upper bound is below +0.05, refuting the predicted magnitude. Mechanism: in all twelve runs the incumbent came from the unchanged fittable lane (promotion-set success 1.00), so exploration candidates could at best tie and ties never promote; both configurations end at 0.94-1.00 on fresh cases. Exploration lane, reported separately (screen success, 10 cases): mean over the lane 0.03 control vs 0.78 v2; best per run 0.10 vs 0.97. The v2 lane does what D-014 predicts, but the fittable lane already saturates the task. Costs per run: control 450 episodes and 11-12 calls; v2 1200 episodes (900 probe) and 10 calls; confirmation 600 episodes. Totals ~10,500 episodes and 133 calls, within the 18,600 / 270 ceiling.

verdicts.reasoning: Six paired blocks: v2 minus control incumbent success on fresh cases is -0.007, run-level paired t95 [-0.035, +0.022]; the upper bound is below +0.05, refuting the predicted improvement of the selected incumbent. The reason is a ceiling, not a failed lane: all twelve incumbents came from the unchanged fittable lane at 1.00 promotion-set success, so exploration candidates could only tie, and ties never promote. The new lane itself works as D-014 predicted: exploration screen success rose from a mean of 0.03 to 0.78 (best per run 0.10 to 0.97) for 10 instead of 11-12 LLM calls and ~750 extra probe episodes per run.
verdicts.next_experiment: Keep two_lane_search_v2 as an option, not the default, on push-v2: the fittable lane already saturates it. The v2 lane's value is for tasks or settings without a strong seed bank; test it on a harder MetaWorld task (or with the fittable lane disabled) where the incumbent is not at ceiling.

verdicts.reasoning: The named fresh-rerun control was measured across six paired blocks [logs/r018]. The incumbent paired_success_difference was -0.00667, with a run-level 95% interval of [-0.03534, +0.02201]; the upper bound is below the predicted +0.05, refuting the predicted magnitude [logs/r018]. Because that interval includes zero, it does not establish a performance difference in either direction [logs/r018]. Every selected incumbent came from the fittable lane; best exploration screen success averaged 0.9667 versus 0.1000 for control, but this screening comparison does not establish the secondary held-out prediction [logs/r018]. That secondary prediction remains inconclusive; paired fresh-confirmation success of the screen-selected exploration winners is the missing measurement [logs/r018].
